scenario: US battery storage capacity additions: forecast-to-reported outcome
audience: Energy infrastructure analyst monitoring a deployment threshold

sourceRights.attribution: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Today in Energy
sourceRights.scope: Short article text excerpts only; no logos, images or third-party material.

qualification: Exact UTF-8 excerpt bytes transcribed from the public article text, not full raw HTML or a SUTRA transport receipt. Same publisher, distinct publication dates; not independent corroboration. The second article reports observed additions rather than correcting the earlier forecast. Figures rounded as published. This is an explicit scenario substitution, not a claim that either article is false.

sources.excerpt: Developers plan to add another 15 GW in 2024
Generators added 10.4 GW of new battery storage capacity in 2024

analystThreshold.text: Analyst review threshold: 12 GW in 2024. Planned additions are not observed outcomes.
analystThreshold.rule: Hypothetical monitoring threshold, chosen as 80% of the rounded 15 GW forecast; not an EIA policy.

expected.decisionConsequence: Flag the threshold for analyst review; forecast scenario is 3 GW above threshold and reported outcome is 1.6 GW below. No automatic operational or financial action.
